hook: Building multi-service apps on Vercel just got incredibly simpler and more secure.
body: Vercel just introduced a new feature called Service Bindings, completely streamlining how your internal services communicate. Imagine connecting a Next.js frontend with a FastAPI backend effortlessly, all within the same deployment. Vercel now automatically injects necessary environment variables and handles all the secure routing, authentication, and TLS behind the scenes. This means less boilerplate for you, letting you focus purely on application logic instead of the complex plumbing of multi-service architectures.
